name: divider-9to3
prompt: Build a resistive voltage divider that produces 3.0 V from a 9 V battery, drawing no more than 1 mA from the battery, with the output on a net named VOUT.
notes: Two constraints at once: the ratio (1/3) and the total resistance (>= 9 kOhm). A stock 10k/10k answer fails the ratio; a 1k/2k answer fails the current budget.
